content:
Track: SQL Foundations
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
    - Lesson 3: Filtering with WHERE Clause
    - Lesson 4: Sorting and Order By Clause
    - Lesson 5: Data Manipulation (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE)
    - Lesson 6: Joins (Inner, Outer, Left Outer, Right Outer)
    - Lesson 7: Subqueries and Nested Queries
    - Lesson 8: Aggregations and GROUP BY Clauses
    - Lesson 9: Data Security with SQL (Privileges, Grants)
    - Lesson 10: Advanced Query Optimization Techniques

   Track: Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Python
    - Lesson 2: Data Types and Structures in Python
    - Lesson 3: Reading and Writing Data with Pandas
    - Lesson 4: Data Cleaning and Preprocessing
    - Lesson 5: Data Visualization Basics with Matplotlib
    - Lesson 6: Advanced Plotting and Charts
    - Lesson 7: Working with Large Datasets using Multiprocessing
    - Lesson 8: Introduction to Libraries (NumPy, SciPy)
    - Lesson 9: Data Analysis Techniques (Correlation, Regression, Hypothesis Testing)
    - Lesson 10: Building Custom Functions for Data Analysis

   Track: Excel Mastery for Analysts
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Excel Formulas and Functions
    - Lesson 2: Advanced Excel Function Usage (IF, VLOOKUP, INDEX)
    - Lesson 3: Pivot Tables and Charts Creation
    - Lesson 4: Data Cleaning Techniques in Excel
    - Lesson 5: Introduction to Power Query for Data Transformations
    - Lesson 6: Advanced Data Analysis with Excel (Data Validation, Scenario Manager)
    - Lesson 7: Macros and VBA Programming in Excel
    - Lesson 8: Creating Dashboards and Reports in Excel
    - Lesson 9: Power Pivot for Large Data Handling
    - Lesson 10: Advanced Techniques for Modeling and Forecasting with Excel

   Track: Intro to Statistics for Analysts
    - Lesson 1: Probability Distributions (Normal, Binomial, Poisson)
    - Lesson 2: Central Limit Theorem and Confidence Intervals
    - Lesson 3: Descriptive Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, Range)
    - Lesson 4: Inferential Statistics (T-Test, ANOVA, Chi-Square Test)
    - Lesson 5: Regression Analysis Basics
    - Lesson 6: Correlation and Covariance
    - Lesson 7: Hypothesis Testing and Null Hypothesis
    - Lesson 8: Sampling Techniques and Error Types
    - Lesson 9: Confidence Intervals and Margin of Error
    - Lesson 10: Power Analysis and Sample Size Determination

   Track: Introduction to Data Ethics
    - Lesson 1: Understanding Data Privacy Laws (GDPR, CCPA)
    - Lesson 2: Ethical Principles for Handling Data
    - Lesson 3: Bias in Data Collection and Analysis
    - Lesson 4: Data Security Best Practices
    - Lesson 5: Informed Consent and Data Anonymization
    - Lesson 6: Data Minimization and Retention Policies
    - Lesson 7: Responsible Use of AI and Machine Learning
    - Lesson 8: Data Governance and Compliance Strategies
    - Lesson 9: Ethics in Freelance Data Analysis Projects
    - Lesson 10: Case Studies and Real-World Scenarios
